name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Pink Runtz
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Pink Runtz half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Pink Runtz brings a sweet, candy-forward profile: sugary berry and citrus candy notes up front with a smooth, dessert-like finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Pink Runtz flavor — sweet candy fruit with a smooth, dessert-like finish

My Zypps Pink Runtz is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
